title: More Scoreboards
description: This mod adds more scoreboard criteria for creating different scoreboards on custom servers, allowing for personalized rankings and more.
body:
<details>
<summary>Mod Introduction (Machine translation)</summary>

This mod adds more scoreboard criteria for creating different scoreboards on custom servers, allowing for personalized rankings and more.

## Core Features

### New Criteria

- `[Namespace]_by_tag:[Name]`：Statistics based on tags. For example, `minecraft.mined_by_tag:minecraft.base_stone_overworld` represents the total number of blocks of stone in the Overworld mined by a player.

### Special Placeholders

- `morescoreboards.total`：Used for the name part of `[Namespace]_by_tag:[Name]`, representing the total sum of all contents under this statistic.

## Example

```mcfunction
/scoreboard objectives add used minecraft.used_by_tag:morescoreboards.total "Usage Items Ranking"
```

</details>

<details>
<summary>模组介绍</summary>

本模组增加了更多计分板准则，用于在定制服务器组合不同的计分板，提供个性化排名等。

## 核心功能

### 新准则

- `[命名空间]_by_tag:[名称]`：统计信息的标签版。例如，`minecraft.mined_by_tag:minecraft.base_stone_overworld`
  表示某玩家挖掘主世界石头的个数之和。

### 特殊占位符

- `morescoreboards.total`：用于`[命名空间]_by_tag:[名称]`的名称部分，表示该统计信息下的所有内容之和。

## 示例

```mcfunction
/scoreboard objectives add used minecraft.used_by_tag:morescoreboards.total "使用物品榜"
```

</details>
